# Automatos AI

> One OS. Any interface. Automatos OS is the open-source (Apache 2.0),
> API-first engine: agents, memory, retrieval, knowledge graphs, NL2SQL,
> documents and socials, governed by a harness of budgets, standards and
> approvals. Automatos Studio is where you run it; Automatos Academy and
> Automatos Markets are products built on it. Built in Lisbon.

## The OS and the family

- [Home](https://automatos.app/): What Automatos OS is, the products that run on it, the editions and the architecture.
- [Automatos Studio](https://studio.automatos.app/#waitlist): The control panel for the OS and your business. Hosted beta opens November 2026 · Join the waitlist. Also runs locally today from the open-source repo (Apache 2.0).
- [Automatos Academy](https://academy.automatos.app): Free certification prep with an AI tutor, powered by Automatos AI.
- [Automatos Markets](https://markets.automatos.app): A read-only crypto market-intelligence product, powered by Automatos AI. Free during the pilot; not financial advice.
- Editions: Local (open source, Apache 2.0, available today), SaaS (hosted beta opens November 2026), Enterprise (coming soon · contact Automatos; a CI-tested Helm chart exists, single sign-on next).

## Compliance

- [EU AI Act](https://automatos.app/eu-ai-act): Where Automatos stands against the Act, article by article: in the product today, partly there, in progress, or on the roadmap. Not certified.
- [EU AI Act checker](https://automatos.app/eu-ai-act/checker): A free five-question classifier that runs in the browser.

## Writing

- [Field notes](https://automatos.app/field-notes): Operator-first writing on routing, missions, memory, and the field. Weekly plus or minus. From the team and pilot operators.
- [Research](https://automatos.app/research): Original practitioner papers on multi-agent coordination, semantic memory, and AI orchestration. Built and tested on the Automatos platform.

## Architecture (one-paragraph each)

- **Universal router**: five-tier routing (override → cache → rules → semantic → LLM) so the cheapest competent answer wins.
- **Mission engine**: natural-language goal → directed acyclic graph of tasks. Coordinator stays stateless; agents request capabilities at runtime.
- **Layered memory**: focus (seconds), working (minutes), short-term (hours), long-term (days), knowledge (corpus). Each layer has its own retrieval and consolidation policy.
- **Skills + tools**: a tool is a verb; a skill is a hire-able trait that bundles tools, prompts, and policy. Skills are the unit of composition.
